title: RBI Mandates 52-Character UTI for OTC Derivatives
summary: Unique Transaction Identifier (UTI) becomes mandatory for OTC rupee interest rate and FX derivatives from 1 January 2027.

blocks.title: 📰 2. 🏛️ REGULATORY BODIES NEWS
blocks.text: 🪝 RBI Mandates 52-Character UTI for OTC Derivatives. Key development for Banking & General Awareness.

items: RBI mandated a **52-character Unique Transaction Identifier (UTI)** for all direct private OTC derivative trades, reported to CCIL-TR.
